name: How should a homeowner prepare before a bathroom tile project begins?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare before a bathroom tile project begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a bathroom tile installation, homeowners should select and order all plumbing fixtures, valves, and tile materials in advance to avoid construction delays. You should decide on preferred layout patterns, such as stacked, herringbone, or running bond, as well as grout colors and matching trim pieces like bullnose or metal edges. Clearing out personal toiletries, towels, and decorative items helps installers access the room easily. It is also beneficial to verify with the contractor where tools will be staged and which pathways through the home will be protected during tear-out.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose tile, grout colors, and fixtures in advance. Clear all personal items from the bathroom and establish protected work pathways through the home with your remodeling team.
